name: greeting-header
title: Greeting header
description: A dashboard welcome: a greeting that follows the hour in your time zone, today's date, one sentence from your counts with links, and a primary action.
docs: Needs no client code: it renders from props, so it works in a Server Component when the action is a link. Always pass `timeZone` (the user's, not the server's) and, for a stable first render, `now` from the server. A count of zero drops out of the sentence; with none left it says you are all caught up.
